Question:
Among Formula 1 drivers who raced during the 1950s, which drivers completed a season in that decade with the same constructor in both the first and the last race they participated in, while also taking part in at least two distinct race rounds during that season?

4 candidates were produced independently. Each shows its SQL and the first rows of its result.

SQL:
WITH driver_seasons AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year,
        res.driver_id,
        MIN(r.round) as first_round,
        MAX(r.round) as last_round,
        COUNT(DISTINCT r.round) as distinct_rounds
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
    WHERE r.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
    GROUP BY r.year, res.driver_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.round) >= 2
),
constructor_first_last AS (
    SELECT 
        ds.year,
        ds.driver_id,
        ds.first_round,
        ds.last_round,
        (SELECT res2.constructor_id 
         FROM results res2 
         JOIN races r2 ON res2.race_id = r2.race_id 
         WHERE r2.year = ds.year 
           AND res2.driver_id = ds.driver_id 
           AND r2.round = ds.first_round 
         LIMIT 1) as first_constructor,
        (SELECT res2.constructor_id 
         FROM results res2 
         JOIN races r2 ON res2.race_id = r2.race_id 
         WHERE r2.year = ds.year 
           AND res2.driver_id = ds.driver_id 
           AND r2.round = ds.last_round 
         LIMIT 1) as last_constructor
    FROM driver_seasons ds
    GROUP BY ds.year, ds.driver_id, ds.first_round, ds.last_round
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    d.forename,
    d.surname
FROM constructor_first_last c
JOIN driver_seasons ds ON c.year = ds.year AND c.driver_id = ds.driver_id
JOIN drivers d ON c.driver_id = d.driver_id
WHERE c.first_constructor = c.last_constructor
ORDER BY d.surname, d.forename

WITH driver_year_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        driver_id,
        MIN(first_round) as first_round,
        MAX(last_round) as last_round,
        COUNT(*) as drive_count
    FROM drives 
    WHERE year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
    GROUP BY year, driver_id
),
first_round_constructor AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        driver_id,
        constructor_id
    FROM drives d1
    WHERE (year, driver_id) IN (
        SELECT year, driver_id FROM driver_year_stats
    )
    AND first_round = (
        SELECT first_round FROM driver_year_stats d2 
        WHERE d2.year = d1.year AND d2.driver_id = d1.driver_id 
        ORDER BY first_round 
        LIMIT 1
    )
),
last_round_constructor AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        driver_id,
        constructor_id
    FROM drives d1
    WHERE (year, driver_id) IN (
        SELECT year, driver_id FROM driver_year_stats
    )
    AND last_round = (
        SELECT last_round FROM driver_year_stats d2 
        WHERE d2.year = d1.year AND d2.driver_id = d1.driver_id 
        ORDER BY last_round DESC 
        LIMIT 1
    )
),
qualifying_seasons AS (
    SELECT 
        dy.year,
        dy.driver_id,
        dy.first_round,
        dy.last_round,
        frc.constructor_id as constructor_id
    FROM driver_year_stats dy
    JOIN first_round_constructor frc ON dy.year = frc.year AND dy.driver_id = frc.driver_id
    JOIN last_round_constructor lrc ON dy.year = lrc.year AND dy.driver_id = lrc.driver_id
    WHERE dy.first_round < dy.last

WITH driver_race_rounds AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year,
        res.driver_id,
        res.constructor_id,
        r.round,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, res.driver_id ORDER BY r.round ASC) as rn_first,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, res.driver_id ORDER BY r.round DESC) as rn_last
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
    WHERE r.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
),
driver_season_bounds AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        driver_id,
        MIN(round) as first_round,
        MAX(round) as last_round
    FROM driver_race_rounds
    GROUP BY year, driver_id
),
qualified_drivers AS (
    SELECT 
        dsb.year,
        dsb.driver_id
    FROM driver_season_bounds dsb
    JOIN driver_race_rounds dr ON dsb.year = dr.year AND dsb.driver_id = dr.driver_id AND dr.rn_first = 1
    JOIN driver_race_rounds dr2 ON dsb.year = dr2.year AND dsb.driver_id = dr2.driver_id AND dr2.rn_last = 1
    WHERE dsb.first_round < dsb.last_round
      AND dr.constructor_id = dr2.constructor_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    d.forename || ' ' || d.surname as driver_name
FROM qualified_drivers qd
JOIN drivers d ON qd.driver_id = d.driver_id
ORDER BY d.driver_id DESC
LIMIT 50

WITH first_drives AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, constructor_id, first_round
    FROM drives
    WHERE year >= 1950 AND year <= 1959
      AND is_first_drive_of_season = '1'::BLOB
),
last_drives AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, constructor_id, last_round
    FROM drives
    WHERE year >= 1950 AND year <= 1959
      AND is_final_drive_of_season = '1'::BLOB
),
qualifying_seasons AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.year, f.driver_id, f.constructor_id, f.first_round, l.last_round
    FROM first_drives f
    JOIN last_drives l ON f.year = l.year AND f.driver_id = l.driver_id
    WHERE f.constructor_id = l.constructor_id
      AND (l.last_round - f.first_round) >= 1
)
SELECT DISTINCT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname as driver_name
FROM qualifying_seasons qs
JOIN drivers d ON qs.driver_id = d.driver_id
ORDER BY d.driver_id
